author: PieZ
body:
The community slack was a great idea to add a new system for people to communicate. If you are new or do not know much about the community slack and want to join
https://avicus.net/forums/5edc7dcc9
The problem I find with slack is that the over all feel of the channels and area is too uptight for our community. There is no real place to go around and lounge or talk about subjects
I could go around making edits on my own but I would like to know the community's opinions on these subjects

My first idea is to add channels.
I would like to add channels that are for a subject. Each of the current channels are for a broad subject and are sometimes uncomfortable to talk about subjects in the general channel. I have a little list of channels that would be fun to add for people's enjoyment

Channels to Add:
Music=Talk about music or add in your own music from your likes
Avicus=Talk about games that are being played, fun TS events, or just anything that has to deal with Avicus's games.
Minecraft=Talk about Minecraft things such as creative, singleplayer,modpacks, anything that has to deal with minecraft
Events=Talk about the next Avicus tournament and bring ideas to the table
Spanish=A whole channel for people wanting to talk in Spanish
World Affairs=For talks on world affairs and news stories
Games=For non-Minecraft games
Memes=For Steven
School=For school related issues
(Maybe)LFS chat=For teams to replace the broken down Skype chat that is currently being used

Delete some unused channels.
The Relations channel has barely to no use anymore. It was up for a time to be used for a way to be able to communicate problems on the server. It was created in a worse time when staff barely knew how to deal with problems on the forums and fights happened every day. With the last few problems, they have been able to be resolved without that channel.

This post was created to get a feedback on if any of these channels look good or for the community to give their feedback on some possible new additions to the community slack. Please give me your feedback
